### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>grpc/grpc-go (google.golang.org/grpc)</summary>

### [`v1.85.0`](https://redirect.github.com/grpc/grpc-go/releases/tag/v1.85.0): Release 1.85.0

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/grpc/grpc-go/compare/v1.84.0...v1.85.0)

### New Features

- stats: Expose the effective client authority (sent on the wire as the HTTP/2 `:authority` header) in client `stats.OutHeader` events. ([#​9296](https://redirect.github.com/grpc/grpc-go/issues/9296))
  - Special Thanks: [@​aryansk](https://redirect.github.com/aryansk)
- metadata: Add `ValueFromOutgoingContext`, which reads a single metadata value from outgoing context without copying the entire outgoing metadata into a new map. ([#​9282](https://redirect.github.com/grpc/grpc-go/issues/9282))
  - Special Thanks: [@​yuyangguo42](https://redirect.github.com/yuyangguo42)

### Bug Fixes

- transport: Refine control buffer throttling to only count peer-induced control frames, raise the default `GRPC_GO_EXPERIMENTAL_CONTROL_BUFFER_THROTTLE_LIMIT` from 100 to 10,000, and close client connections if reads remain throttled for `10s`. ([#​9563](https://redirect.github.com/grpc/grpc-go/issues/9563))
- server: Ensure `Stop()` forcefully terminates the server while `GracefulStop()` is waiting for active handlers to complete. ([#​9394](https://redirect.github.com/grpc/grpc-go/issues/9394))
  - Special Thanks: [@​stanhu](https://redirect.github.com/stanhu)
- server: Unconditionally increment the highest-seen stream ID on when handling `HEADERS` frames to comply with [RFC 7540 §5.1.1](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7540.html#section-5.1.1). Previously, truncated `HEADERS` frames left the connection in an inconsistent state and allowed stream IDs to be reused by clients without resulting in a protocol error. ([#​9414](https://redirect.github.com/grpc/grpc-go/issues/9414))
- server: Terminate streams immediately when a `HEADERS` frame includes the `EndStream` bit. Previously, this caused server handlers to hang when reading a message. ([#​9391](https://redirect.github.com/grpc/grpc-go/issues/9391))
- server: Reject requests missing both `:authority` and `Host` headers with HTTP 400 and status `Internal`. ([#​9365](https://redirect.github.com/grpc/grpc-go/issues/9365))
- xds: Fix a bug where route header matchers with non-lowercase names failed to match routes. ([#​9353](https://redirect.github.com/grpc/grpc-go/issues/9353))
  - Special Thanks: [@​winklemad](https://redirect.github.com/winklemad)
- client: Ensure retried RPCs use the correct `:authority` value specified by the LB policy instead of inheriting it from a previous attempt. ([#​9277](https://redirect.github.com/grpc/grpc-go/issues/9277))
  - Special Thanks: [@​nvxbug](https://redirect.github.com/nvxbug)
- transport: Fail streams with `io.ErrUnexpectedEOF` instead of `io.EOF` upon receiving truncated  message headers or bodies after partial data has already been received. ([#​9204](https://redirect.github.com/grpc/grpc-go/issues/9204))
  - Special Thanks: [@​buger](https://redirect.github.com/buger)

</details>
